businesses.business: home medical devices for chronic conditions

offering_description.value: Develops and sells medical devices, mainly pneumatic compression pumps and garments for lymphedema and chronic venous insufficiency, plus a respiratory airway clearance vest and a wearable for Parkinson's symptoms. Sells to patients through durable medical equipment channels and directly, with clinical support and reimbursement services.

primary_products.value: advanced pneumatic compression devices; lymphedema compression garments; airway clearance vests; wearable neuromodulation devices for Parkinson's

primary_services.value: reimbursement and insurance claims support; patient clinical education and training; device fitting and home setup

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients with lymphedema, venous disease, chronic lung conditions or Parkinson's using devices at home; B2G: Veterans Affairs and Medicare programs as payers and purchasers; B2B: durable medical equipment providers and clinics

end_markets.value: healthcare; home medical equipment; lymphatic care; respiratory care; neurology

revenue_model.value: product sales: compression pumps, garments and vests sold to patients, providers and the VA; healthcare reimbursement: payments from Medicare, Medicaid and commercial insurers for devices

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and makes therapy devices and garments, sold to patients, DME providers and the VA; service provider: provides patient support and billing to insurers

geography_served.value: US national: Patients across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: lymphedema and venous compression, airway clearance and Parkinson's wearable devices for home use

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: own sales reps selling to clinicians, patients and the VA; distributors / dealers: durable medical equipment suppliers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices needing FDA clearance, Medicare and insurer reimbursement rules, HIPAA and fraud and abuse laws
